name: Research Agent
description: Conducts web research and produces structured reports with citations on any business topic.

specJson.goal: Research and rank open-source project management productivity apps based on GitHub stars (minimum 50) and recent Reddit activity in r/programming and r/webdev (past 30 days), returning top 10 in table format
outputs: Markdown comparison table with columns [Rank, App Name, GitHub Stars, Reddit Score]
steps: Search for open-source project management tools on GitHub using keywords 'project management', 'task manager', 'workflow tool' and filters (minimum 50 stars, recent commits within last 6 months)
Gather repository data including star counts, forks, commit history from GitHub API
Monitor r/programming and r/webdev communities for recent discussions about these apps in the past 30 days using Reddit search with keywords matching GitHub repo names
Calculate composite scores weighting GitHub stars at 60% and Reddit mentions/comments at 40%
Rank candidates using calculated composite score (minimum 50 stars, recent commits within last 6 months)
Generate markdown table with top 10 ranked applications
